Agent Name: Planner  
Step Number: 1  
Reason for Mistake: The Planner incorrectly calculated the time required for the airplane to travel 200 kilometers. The Planner computed the time as \( \text{Time} = \frac{\text{Distance}}{\text{Speed}} = \frac{200}{800} = 0.25 \, \text{hours} \), which is correct so far. However, when converting 0.25 hours to minutes, the Planner mistakenly concluded that 0.25 hours equals **25 minutes** instead of the correct conversion of \( 0.25 \times 60 = 15 \, \text{minutes} \). This led to the selection of the wrong option (B instead of A) and the termination of the task with an incorrect answer.
